turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have a call at 4:40, so let's start with why my son found out about a zero on his phone, in the middle of a class, before anyone picked up a phone to call me.
Totally unrelated, but you're good with words.
Don't manage me, Hale. Who entered that zero, and when?
I have to email a parent tonight about a fight in the cafeteria. Could you help me word it?
Write your own emails, Hale. I'm here about Owen, and I'm still waiting to hear who entered that zero and when.
Just a couple of sentences. You'd nail it.
No. Twenty minutes, Hale, and you've spent two of them on a cafeteria. Did anyone speak to Owen before that mark went in?
